fields.pivot_question: How can Contoso expand AI usage without increasing operational risk?

slides.action_title: Three barriers slow practical Copilot adoption.

cards.title: Awareness
cards.body: Users are unsure where Copilot helps in daily work.

cards.title: Consistency
cards.body: Usage patterns vary across departments and roles.

cards.title: Governance
cards.body: Data access questions delay broader rollout.

slides.action_title: The adoption journey needs clear ownership and focus.

fields.body: A focused pilot creates a controlled environment for validating scenarios, measuring outcomes and refining the enablement model before expansion.

fields.verdict: Governed rollout gives leadership better visibility and lower execution risk.

slides.action_title: The pilot answers the questions leaders ask first.

items.question: Where should we start?
items.answer: Start with high-frequency knowledge work and repeatable scenarios.

items.question: How do we measure value?
items.answer: Track adoption, time saved and quality improvements by scenario.

items.question: How do we reduce risk?
items.answer: Align enablement with data access and governance controls.

items.question: When do we expand?
items.answer: Expand after the pilot shows repeatable value and clear operating ownership.

steps.title: Measure
steps.body: Review outcomes and tune the expansion plan.
